summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares ESG Advanced MSCI EAFE ETF (DMXF) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI EAFE Choice ESG Screened index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted, ESG-screened index of large- and mid-cap stocks from the developed markets outside North America. DMXF was launched on Jun 16, 2020 and is issued by BlackRock.
infoTable: MSCI EAFE Choice ESG Screened Index

holdings.infoBox: DMXF is an equity ETF with a total of 426 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 6.49%, Novartis AG at 2.42%, Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group at 2.26%, SAP SE at 1.98%, and Schneider Electric S.E. at 1.68%.
